📦 **LY `f33ad117a`** — docs(codex): clarify Senate skill entry handling

Make a skill-defined Senate entry command take precedence over the generic watcher-status check, so ritual workflows retain their required first action.

Also distinguish terminal setup failures before command launch from Senate or Unity command failures, with one retry for read-only commands.

## 順手修掉的（Q0）

無；本筆只補正 Codex 指令的流程邊界，沒有夾帶實作修正。

👥 參與者：@meadow
